contract: ../../web-design-contract.md: public URL form, real progress/cancellation, private temporary report, downloads, responsive report viewer.

accessibility.evidence: test/web.test.ts ran axe WCAG A/AA checks at both sizes with zero violations and exercised labeled URL/permission controls, submit, report result, and new scan. Manual screenshots show visible keyboard focus; reduced-motion CSS disables progress animation.

responsive.evidence: Automated no-overflow assertions passed at 1440 and 390 pixels. Reviewed desktop and mobile screenshots: form stacks, heading wraps, controls fit, and scope explanation follows the primary action.

loading.evidence: Submitted an actual studio-site scan through the isolated Compose deployment; real opening/scanning progress and cancellation control appeared.

empty.evidence: Initial URL-entry state reviewed at both widths and exercised by the browser test; no report or fabricated result is displayed before a scan.

error.evidence: API tests reject invalid/private URLs and missing consent, enforce rate limits, and return a recoverable scan failure without internal errors. An initial local container configuration failure was displayed with Try another scan, then corrected.

partial.evidence: Real scan of three studio-site pages completed with manual-review checks; the app displayed the partial-coverage note and the embedded report.

success.evidence: Browser test completes form-to-report with an injected deterministic runner; actual isolated scan produced a three-page report with twenty checked links and working report routes.

permission.evidence: Authorization checkbox is required in browser and server validation. Public-address validation and cross-session report denial are covered by tests; proxy tests reject private/reserved addresses.

renderedEvidence.observation: Desktop form after real scan, with focus visible and four numbered scan outputs.
Mobile form, stacked primary action, permission checkbox, scan limits, and scope section.
